en-GB.strc_barracks_text:
Recruits land units.

Available units:
Soldier, Dog, Spearman, Mage, Archer, Cavalry, Ballista, Trebuchet, Giant, Wagon

Income: None
Reinforce? Yes
en-GB.strc_exchange_depot_text:
Exchanges a ground unit for a naval unit (and vice versa).

You pay the difference in cost between the current unit and the desired unit. The cost is discounted based on the health of the current unit. There is no cost to trade for a unit of equal or lesser value.

Income: None
Reinforce? Yes
en-GB.strc_fort_village_text:
Fortified villages are more difficult to defeat, having ~1.1x the defence of normal villages

Income: 200 G
Reinforce? Yes
en-GB.strc_general_text:
▶  Before you can use a
structure, you must capture 
it for your team. 

▶  Only certain units can capture
structures, including Soldiers,
Air Troopers, and Riverboats.
en-GB.strc_general_text2:
▶  Units can heal at certain structures by using Reinforce. 
▶  This transfers health from the structure to the unit in need of reinforcement.

[ Health regeneration ]
● Unless otherwise stated, all structures regenerate 10 health at the start of each turn.
en-GB.strc_hideout_text:
Recruits rabble-rousers. 

Available units:
Thief, Rifleman

Note: Stolen gold must be deposited at a Hideout before it becomes available to use.

Income: None
Reinforce? No
en-GB.strc_lumber_mill_text:
Harvest surrounding Forest tiles for gold. A single Forest is worth 100 gold, but cutting multiple forests in the same turn will yield bigger bonuses:

1 → 100  || 5 →  750
2 → 250 || 6 → 900
3 → 400 || 7 → 1050
4 → 600 || 8 → 1200

A harvested forest tile becomes a Cut Forest tile. At the start of each turn, one forest will regrow at random from cut forest tiles surrounding a Lumber Mill.

Income: None
Reinforce? Yes
en-GB.strc_port_text:
Recruits naval units.

Available units:
Barge, Riverboat, Amphibian, Turtle, Frog, Harpoon Ship, Warship, Kraken

Income: None
Reinforce? Yes
en-GB.strc_portal_text:
▲ Instantly transport a unit to any other portal under your control.
▲ A unit cannot teleport to a portal that lacks an available adjacent tile.

Income: None
Reinforce? Yes
en-GB.strc_stronghold_text:
Strongholds are special structures that can be destroyed but not captured.

Generally, losing your Stronghold is an instant Defeat condition (while destroying the opponent's Stronghold will win you the game).

Income | 100 G
Reinforce? | No
en-GB.strc_tower_text:
Recruits air units.

Available units:
Air Trooper, Aeronaut, Sky Rider, Dragon, Balloon

Income: None
Reinforce? Yes
en-GB.strc_treasure_chest_text:
Open a treasure chest to release the item(s) inside. See the Item codex for specific item info.

Note for Map-Makers:
After placing a treasure chest, use the Properties tool to select specific items and the number of items dropped.
If you select more items than the Drop Number, the game will choose items at random from your selection pool.
en-GB.strc_village_text:
Income: 100 gold per turn
Reinforce? Yes

Note for Map-Makers
Villages, Sea Villages, and River Villages are all functionally identical, but map-makers are restricted in where each can be placed. 

* Villages --> Road and Plains only
* Sea villages --> Sea, Deep Sea, and Reef
* River villages --> River only
en-GB.strc_watchtower_text:
Upon capture, Watchtowers reveal Fog of War in a 5-tile radius. (Only the team controlling the Watchtower can see this).

Watchtower's sight uncovers enemies that would otherwise be hidden in Forest and Reef tiles.

Resting at Watchtower allows a unit to recover 30 health. (Cost: 200 gold)

Income: None
Reinforce? No
